links.outcome: Concordance of AI ECG interpretation and management with emergency physician reference
links.effect: Agreement in 18 of 20 cases (90%), kappa 0.80; failed on fusion beats (0/1) and torsades (0/1), omitting IV magnesium sulfate despite recognizing the condition.
links.quote: In the torsades case, ChatGPT did not recommend intravenous magnesium sulfate-the standard first-line treatment-despite recognizing the condition.

links.outcome: Reliability of AI ECG interpretation as stand-alone diagnosis/management
links.effect: 90% concordance overall, but discrepancies in complex cases and critical management recommendations; authors do not support independent AI use.
links.quote: Our findings from this pilot study do not support the independent use of AI for definitive ECG interpretation or emergency management decisions; it should serve as an adjunct tool that enhances rather than supplants human clinical judgment.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4 on interpreting 20 ECG cases compared to an emergency physician reference standard, without evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
